name: It was a Sunny Day outside
source:
Maple and Shin are just two regular high school students, but what happens when those around them start to disappear? What will happen when they are forced to realize the reality of their situation? And do they have enough time?

[From [url=https://winteriris13.itch.io/sunny-day]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梅普露和申只是两个普通的高中生，但是当他们周围的人开始消失时会发生什么呢？当他们被迫认识到自己的现实处境时，会发生什么？他们有足够的时间吗？

[来自[url=https://winteriris13.itch.io/sunny-day]itch.io[/url]]
